data.body: GAP_ANALYSIS_AMENDMENT (2/4): CASCADE_E2E_LOG mktemp template and cleanup. (1) Use mktemp -d /tmp/cascade-e2e.XXXXXX (not -t flag; macOS/GNU divergence). (2) trap 'rm -rf ${CASCADE_E2E_LOG}' EXIT INT TERM immediately after creation. (3) Pre-cascade assert ticket-calls.log and dispatch-calls.log do not exist yet (catches leaked state). (4) Preserve on failure when CASCADE_E2E_KEEP=1. taxonomy: state_file_conflict
